acceptanceCriteria: A dispatcher worker can end its session while its detached run continues, without the dispatcher stopping the supervisor or releasing the attempt (V1-0858 criteria).
When the detached command finishes, the dispatcher launches one session for the same ticket and role with the run outcome in its launch context, exactly once per finished run.
Maintained tests: worker exits, run continues, run finishes, successor launched once with the outcome; a forged record neither exempts a process nor triggers a launch.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#651 (owner: get it fixed and merged).

Observed: agent sessions stay open only to poll long detached lane commands (1,644 sleep/tail polls and 2,555 context checks in 24 h); each poll resends 100k-190k tokens of context, and sessions hit their context stop mid-wait and lose the run. Depends on V1-0858 (dispatcher adoption of detached runs), which this delivery must include.

Ask: a worker starts run --attempt --detach, records its next step and ends; the runner keeps the attempt heartbeated; when the command exits the dispatcher relaunches a session for that ticket and role with the run outcome (exit status, receipt, log path) in its launch context; optionally a compact attach wait.
